tokens.name: text.primary
tokens.usage: `textColor="primary"`. Strongest text, such as titles and body copy. 14.95:1 on `background.primary`; WCAG AA: any text.

tokens.name: text.secondary
tokens.usage: `textColor="secondary"`. Text one level below primary, such as details. 9.91:1 on `background.primary`; WCAG AA: any text.

tokens.name: text.secondary_inverse
tokens.usage: `textColor="secondary_inverse"`. Secondary text on `background.contrast`. 9.01:1 on `background.contrast`; WCAG AA: any text.

tokens.name: text.tertiary
tokens.usage: `textColor="tertiary"`. The lightest text level; reach for it only for a real third level. 6.67:1 on `background.primary`; WCAG AA: any text.

tokens.name: text.tertiary_inverse
tokens.usage: `textColor="tertiary_inverse"`. Tertiary text on `background.contrast`. 7.93:1 on `background.contrast`; WCAG AA: any text.

tokens.name: text.display

tokens.name: text.price

tokens.name: text.error

tokens.name: text.caution
tokens.usage: `textColor="caution"`. Caution messages. 8.77:1 on `background.primary`; WCAG AA: any text.

tokens.name: text.success
tokens.usage: `textColor="success"`. Success messages. 6.42:1 on `background.primary`; WCAG AA: any text.

tokens.name: text.attention
tokens.usage: `textColor="attention"`. Text that needs attention. 4.95:1 on `background.primary`; WCAG AA: any text.

tokens.name: text.disabled

tokens.name: text.placeholder
